expected: The PUT-then-GET round-trip of the workflow-model policy overlay must be deterministic: after a banner-OK save, GET ?context=default always carries contexts.default.workflows.
notes: Both retry attempts inside the failing run hit the same undefined shape, suggesting an env/state interaction in the fresh bootstrap workspace rather than a timing race. Redacted; CI-only observation.
repro: Run the e2e-panel CI leg repeatedly on the same sha; observed once on a pull_request-event run while the push-event run passed. Not reproducible locally (isolated spec and full suite both green).
symptom: On one of two CI runs of the SAME commit, 'Harness toggle persists through PUT' failed both attempts with TypeError reading 'implementation' — polBody.policy.contexts.default.workflows was undefined after a banner-OK save. The parallel run of the same sha passed, and the full local suite passes 53/53.
title: workflow-policy-harness-toggle e2e flakes on GHA: policy GET returns overlay without contexts.default.workflows
